company.shortDescription: Open-source Observability platform for Agent native era
company.description: SigNoz is an open source observability platform built for agent native era.  Traces, metrics, and logs in a unified, OpenTelemetry-native platform.

productsAndServices.description: A tool to monitor and troubleshoot application performance by collecting and analyzing telemetry data such as metrics, traces, and logs.
productsAndServices.name: Application Performance Monitoring (APM)

productsAndServices.description: Tracks user requests across multiple services to identify performance bottlenecks and trace the flow of operations in distributed systems.
productsAndServices.name: Distributed Tracing

productsAndServices.description: Ingests, searches, and analyzes logs from various sources at scale to support troubleshooting and monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Log Management

productsAndServices.description: Provides infrastructure monitoring, custom metrics collection, and configurable dashboards for visualizing telemetry data.
productsAndServices.name: Metrics and Dashboards

productsAndServices.description: Automatically records exceptions with stack traces and linked span data to aid in debugging and error analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Exceptions Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: Enables creation of actionable alerts based on telemetry data, delivered through preferred notification channels.
productsAndServices.name: Alerts Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,400,000, or 83.08% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,234,119 to $29,247,275, a 3.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 33 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
